thinking_text:
**Clarifying frame geometry**

I’m thinking about the frame's geometry. It seems like it’s not just the base side but also the entire right and front planar face that connects as one continuous surface. So when I mention z=0, I’m considering the outer planar surface as part of the overall structure. There’s a large silhouette in the front, which might indicate that z is at zero. I need to ensure I have this correctly mapped out!

part.name: Pedestal-mounted C-frame bracket with threaded top boss
part.description: Single-piece mechanical bracket comprising an elongated two-hole mounting flange, a curved upright load frame, an open lower jaw or clevis cavity, paired side guide slots, a rectangular upper head, a transverse locating bore, and a reinforced axial threaded boss on top.
part.symmetry_note: The base flange, top boss, upper transverse bore, and many head features are approximately symmetric about the mid-thickness plane z=-21 mm. The longitudinal C-frame profile and lower jaw are not symmetric end-to-end. The two base mounting holes are positioned symmetrically near opposite ends of the 168 mm flange.

Section.name: Mounting base flange
Section.function intent: Mounts the bracket to a machine bed or support plate and establishes a stable positional datum.
Section.physical behavior: The broad flange bears against the support, while the two separated through holes accept fasteners and resist translation and rotation. The elongated footprint spreads upright-frame loads into the support and reduces local bearing stress.
Section.geometry: A long rectangular plate extending beyond both sides of the upright, with a constant 15 mm vertical thickness, semicylindrical corner rounds, two circular through holes, and broad parallel top and bottom faces.
Section.location: Bottom of the part, spanning the full x length and full z width.

major_faces.description: Large horizontal upper surface of the flange surrounding the upright and both mounting holes.

major_faces.name: Right mounting-hole bore
major_faces.description: Cylindrical radius-7.5 mm through-hole wall near x=153 mm.

major_faces.name: Base underside datum
major_faces.description: Large horizontal bottom face intended to seat against a mating support.

major_faces.description: Cylindrical radius-7.5 mm through-hole wall near x=15 mm.

major_faces.name: Left upper corner round
major_faces.description: Quarter-cylindrical transition between the left end and the z=0 longitudinal side.

major_faces.name: Left flange end face
major_faces.description: Flat vertical end face at x=0 between the rounded flange corners.

major_faces.name: Left lower corner round
major_faces.description: Quarter-cylindrical transition at the left end on the z=-60 side.

major_faces.name: Outer longitudinal edge face
major_faces.description: Long flat vertical side of the base at z=-60 mm.

major_faces.name: Right lower corner round
major_faces.description: Quarter-cylindrical transition between the right end and the z=-60 side.

major_faces.name: Right flange end face
major_faces.description: Flat vertical end face at x=168 mm between the rounded corners.

Section.name: Curved upright load frame
Section.function intent: Carries loads between the upper functional head and the mounting flange while preserving a large side-access opening.
Section.physical behavior: The deep, thick C-shaped web behaves as a cantilevered frame. Its broad side faces resist bending, the curved outer spine transfers load around the opening, and the generous curved transitions reduce stress concentration at changes in section.
Section.geometry: A thick asymmetric C-frame rising from the base. It includes a broad planar front side, a corresponding back side, a large convex outer arc, a concave inner arch, and blended transitions into the base and upper head.
Section.location: Central portion of the part, above the base and below the upper head.

major_faces.name: Front frame web face
major_faces.description: Large z=0 planar face defining the visible front silhouette of the base-connected frame.

major_faces.name: Outer spine arc
major_faces.description: Large radius-51 mm cylindrical surface forming the convex outer load-carrying curve.

major_faces.name: Outer upright side wall
major_faces.description: Tall planar outer wall joining the curved spine to the lower base region.

major_faces.name: Back frame web face
major_faces.description: Large planar rear face at z=-42 mm defining the opposite side of the frame.

major_faces.name: Lower frame root round
major_faces.description: Radius-9 mm cylindrical root transition between the lower frame and flange.

major_faces.name: Inner lower return arc
major_faces.description: Radius-9 mm cylindrical transition at the lower side of the C-shaped opening.

major_faces.name: Inner opening arch
major_faces.description: Radius-27 mm cylindrical surface forming the principal concave boundary of the access opening.

major_faces.name: Head-side frame wall
major_faces.description: Broad planar wall on the opposite side of the upright, extending from the lower transition toward the upper head.

Section.name: Lower jaw and clevis cavity
Section.function intent: Provides side access and clearance for a mating component, workpiece, latch, or clamp member positioned inside the C-frame opening.
Section.physical behavior: The separated cheek regions laterally locate a mating part while leaving an open central volume. Flat and sloped internal faces can react contact loads, and the surrounding frame carries those loads back toward the mounting flange.
Section.geometry: An open clevis-like cavity near the lower part of the frame, bounded by two recessed planar cheek surfaces, vertical walls, short cylindrical end patches, and an inclined internal face.
Section.location: Lower central-left region of the upright, immediately above the base and inside the large C-shaped opening.

major_faces.name: Near jaw cheek
major_faces.description: Recessed planar cheek face at z=-12 mm defining one side of the lower clevis.

major_faces.name: Jaw end wall
major_faces.description: Flat transverse wall closing one end of the lower jaw cavity.

major_faces.name: Inner jaw side wall
major_faces.description: Vertical planar side face connecting the near and far cheek levels.

major_faces.name: Far jaw cheek
major_faces.description: Opposing recessed planar cheek face at z=-30 mm.

major_faces.name: Far upper cavity ledge
major_faces.description: Horizontal ledge on the far side of the bifurcated cavity.

major_faces.name: Inclined reaction face
major_faces.description: Sloped internal planar surface that guides or reacts against a mating member.

major_faces.name: Near upper cavity ledge
major_faces.description: Horizontal ledge corresponding to the near-side jaw cheek.

Section.name: Upper head block
Section.function intent: Supports and laterally locates the top threaded interface while providing a transverse pin or inspection bore.
Section.physical behavior: The deep rectangular head resists bending beneath the boss. The reduced central web limits mass while the thicker outer cheeks carry load. The transverse bore can accept a small pin, cross-fastener, or alignment feature.
Section.geometry: A box-like upper block with broad side faces, an inset central web, a small transverse radius-3 mm bore, and a rounded upper crown transitioning into the boss seat.
Section.location: Top of the upright frame, directly below the threaded boss.

major_faces.name: Front crown fillet
major_faces.description: Radius-6 mm cylindrical crown transition across the front side of the upper head.

major_faces.name: Boss support shoulder
major_faces.description: Horizontal annular support plane beneath the central top boss.

major_faces.name: Outer head side wall
major_faces.description: Tall planar side face of the upper head containing one opening of the transverse bore.

major_faces.name: Near inset head face
major_faces.description: Large planar face of the reduced-thickness central upper web at z=-12 mm.

major_faces.name: Head cheek wall
major_faces.description: Vertical planar cheek face connecting the inset web to the outer head thickness.

major_faces.name: Far inset head face
major_faces.description: Opposing planar face of the upper central web at z=-30 mm.

major_faces.name: Opposite head cheek wall
major_faces.description: Vertical cheek face on the opposite side of the reduced central web.

major_faces.name: Left transverse-bore wall
major_faces.description: Radius-3 mm cylindrical segment forming one side of the transverse head bore.

major_faces.name: Right transverse-bore wall
major_faces.description: Matching radius-3 mm cylindrical bore segment on the opposite side of the head.

Section.name: Paired side guide slots
Section.function intent: Provides guided travel, adjustment, visual access, or engagement for paired mating pins on opposite sides of the frame.
Section.physical behavior: The parallel slot walls constrain lateral motion, while the rounded ends provide travel limits and reduce stress concentration. The paired arrangement supports balanced loading on both side cheeks.
Section.geometry: Two matching obround pockets or slots located on opposite outer cheeks. Each has two straight vertical walls, semicylindrical radius-9 mm ends, and a planar recessed floor.
Section.location: Lower-to-middle region of the frame cheeks, one slot visible from the front and the other from the back.

major_faces.name: Far slot outer wall
major_faces.description: Straight planar side wall of the slot recessed from the z=-42 side.

major_faces.name: Far slot lower round
major_faces.description: Radius-9 mm semicylindrical end surface at one end of the far slot.

major_faces.name: Far slot inner wall
major_faces.description: Opposing straight planar side wall of the far slot.

major_faces.name: Far slot upper round
major_faces.description: Radius-9 mm semicylindrical end surface at the other end of the far slot.

major_faces.name: Far slot floor
major_faces.description: Planar recessed floor at z=-32 mm bounded by the far slot walls.

major_faces.name: Near slot outer wall
major_faces.description: Straight planar side wall of the matching slot recessed from the z=0 side.

major_faces.name: Near slot upper round
major_faces.description: Radius-9 mm semicylindrical end surface at one end of the near slot.

major_faces.name: Near slot inner wall
major_faces.description: Opposing straight planar side wall of the near slot.

major_faces.name: Near slot lower round
major_faces.description: Radius-9 mm semicylindrical end surface at the other end of the near slot.

major_faces.name: Near slot floor
major_faces.description: Planar recessed floor at z=-10 mm bounded by the near slot walls.

Section.name: Threaded top boss and reinforcement
Section.function intent: Provides the primary axial attachment for a threaded actuator, stud, adjustment screw, fitting, or mating cylindrical component.
Section.physical behavior: The cylindrical boss locates the mating member concentrically, and its internal bore carries axial and torsional thread loads. The annular top face supplies a seating datum, while the toroidal and blended base transitions distribute those loads into the upper head.
Section.geometry: A vertical cylindrical boss centered on the head, with an approximately 7.0175 mm-radius internal bore, a chamfered bore entrance, an outer radius-12 mm cylinder, and a flared reinforced base composed of toroidal and blended patches.
Section.location: Topmost central feature of the part, with its axis parallel to the vertical y direction.

major_faces.name: Bore entry chamfer
major_faces.description: Conical 45-degree lead-in at the top entrance of the axial bore.

major_faces.name: Boss outer cylinder
major_faces.description: Main radius-12 mm cylindrical exterior of the top boss.

major_faces.name: Boss top annulus
major_faces.description: Flat annular top seating face surrounding the bore entrance.

major_faces.name: Right reinforcement torus
major_faces.description: Toroidal fillet patch blending the right side of the boss pedestal into the head.

major_faces.name: Left reinforcement torus
major_faces.description: Matching toroidal fillet patch on the opposite side of the boss pedestal.

major_faces.name: Right pedestal shoulder
major_faces.description: Horizontal shoulder face adjacent to the right side of the reinforced boss base.

major_faces.name: Left pedestal shoulder
major_faces.description: Horizontal shoulder face adjacent to the left side of the reinforced boss base.

major_faces.name: Axial threaded-bore envelope
major_faces.description: Radius-7.0175 mm cylindrical B-rep surface representing the internal tapped or attachment bore.
